asset: ponce-city-market.glb: procedural facsimile of Ponce City Market for the beltline-eastside level, one node per LOD (lod0, lod1, lod2) in each of 4 sections (<key>_s<i>_lod<n>, each node at its section center), shared materials and tiling textures.
tool: Blender 5.2.3 LTS, headless (blender -b -P), glTF 2.0 exporter with Draco
source: scripts/blender/landmarks.py: footprint walls with bays of recessed windows, piers, belts, cornice, parapet, roof, and props, all from code. No photo pixels, scans of the real building, mesh extraction, or logos.
prompt: None. The script and sites.json are the full recipe.
credits: No paid generation credits (Meshy not used).
textures: lm_brick_*, lm_trim_*: the CC0 Poly Haven scans in assets/landmarks/textures/ (see its provenance.json), recolored in code for the buff brick and concrete; lm_window_* (incl. lm_window_emit, the night glow), lm_fence_color, lm_far_pcm_*: painted in code by landmarks.py. TEXCOORD_1 u is the per-window light key.

facts.note: NRHP registration form 16000769, section 7: nine stories plus basement in every section of the main building; central tower with windows on each floor holding the water tank, pyramidal roof; shaped parapets on the end blocks. Tower stage heights above the roof are estimated from the photo references. The one-story shipping room is a separate footprint (heights.json w619595557).
